hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Status bar reporting (superpowers-statusbar plugin): whenever you follow superpowers test-driven-development, including when you execute a plan yourself with superpowers:executing-plans and when you implement a task as a subagent, call the mcp__superpowers-statusbar__report_phase tool each time you move into a TDD phase: red when you start writing a failing test, green when you start writing the code that makes it pass, refactor when you clean up with the tests green. It is a signal only; it changes nothing about how you work.
